cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've pushed your chair back, so I've done the same. Pour for the chairperson first, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I moved mine to make room for a wheelchair. We're passing the water jug round.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, clear passage. Pass it straight to the chairperson, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are two people between us. They haven't had any water either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let them pour, then ask them to pass it to 'Chairperson Jo.' I'd like them to hear who they're passing it to.

reason: Use copied seating adjustment as mistaken precedence; B other diners limits privilege so A seeks a spoken title instead.
